WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled_quantity
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled_quantity) AS value
  FROM order_averages
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_unfilled_quantity,
         oa.avg_unfilled_quantity - g.value AS excess_over_overall
  FROM order_averages oa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average g
  WHERE oa.avg_unfilled_quantity > g.value
),
second_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled_quantity) AS value
  FROM above_overall
),
above_both AS (
  SELECT a.avg_unfilled_quantity, a.excess_over_overall,
         a.avg_unfilled_quantity - s.value AS excess_over_second
  FROM above_overall a
  CROSS JOIN second_average s
  WHERE a.avg_unfilled_quantity > s.value
)
SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled_quantity), AVG(excess_over_overall), AVG(excess_over_second)
FROM above_both;
